items.a: Per room, double occupancy, including all taxes and meals. Extra adult ₹1,200 (10 yrs+); extra child ₹1,000 (5–10 yrs). Pricing is dynamic on weekends, public holidays and peak season - call for the latest quote.
Children are welcome. Pets are not permitted at the property. Smoking is not permitted indoors.
50% advance confirms the booking; the balance is due 7 days before check-in.
For Indian passport holders, a cancellation is issued as a credit note valid for one year from booking. It is transferable and can be redeemed once against a future stay.
Free Wi-Fi throughout the property. Room service is not available.
Kasaragod station ~6 km (20 min); Mangaluru airport ~65 km (1.5 hr); Kannur airport ~91 km (2.5 hr). Pickup is available on request, at extra charge.
